description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Break class, which compiles the {break} tag in Smarty templates. It includes methods to compile PHP code for breaking out of loops and checks attributes like 'levels' to determine how many levels to break.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Break
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {break} tag within Smarty templates, extending base compilation functionalities.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates the PHP code necessary to implement the {break} tag, handling 'levels' and nested loop contexts.

methods.name: checkLevels
methods.description: Validates the 'levels' attribute and determines how many nested loops to break out of.
